MEASURED 2026-10-23 through flo2.io, design SeattleArch (f8160a1cdf905022), reflow2 0.90.0.

WHAT WAS RECORDED: 8 facts from the IFC-against-plan-set check, 4 of them fact_type `defect`. For example, fact:model-roof-top-reads-above-the-max-ridge-2026-10-23 has subject_id con:height (limit 52.708 ft): the model's standing-seam roof reads 52'-11 15/16". Also the six discrepancy facts recorded 10-16.

WHAT READS THEM: nothing.
- open_questions: count 0.
- detect_gaps: 21 gaps, none about any finding.
- detect_defects: 0 defects.
- loop_status: `next` lists unasked gaps and unchecked capabilities, but no open defect and no limit with a measurement over it.
- The constraint con:height still reads like any other limit. A defect fact on it does not make it read broken or in question.

So the person sees "nothing open", while the design holds a measured reading that breaks its own height limit and has not been taken to the architect.
